$comment: Every npm dependency must be listed here with a licence that allows free commercial use. `pnpm check:licenses` fails CI otherwise. Re-verify when adding or upgrading.

@maplibre/maplibre-react-native.note: Open-source MapLibre Native bindings; no key or tile fees

expo.note: Local builds are free; EAS cloud build is optional and has its own free-tier quota

expo-background-task.note: Uses the OS scheduler (BGTaskScheduler / WorkManager); no server

expo-build-properties.note: Build config only (Android cleartext for LAN stations)

expo-iap.note: StoreKit 2 / Play Billing Library 9 directly (openiap). Only the on-device APIs are used; the optional hosted IAPKit / verifyPurchaseWithProvider service is not. v5.8.x (repo moved to hyodotdev/openiap, Aug 2026)

expo-location.note: Uses OS location services only; no third-party location API

expo-notifications.note: Local notifications / OS background scheduling only; no push service or server

expo-secure-store.note: Keychain/Keystore for the user's own station keys and sensor bindkeys

expo-task-manager.note: Uses the OS scheduler (BGTaskScheduler / WorkManager); no server

expo-tracking-transparency.note: Apple ATT prompt, shown only when the user opts in to personalised ads

react-native-ble-plx.note: Passive BLE advertisement scanning; no service involved

react-native-google-mobile-ads.note: AdMob + Google UMP consent (free). Pinned to 16.5.0: 17.x needs React Native 0.86 (Expo SDK 57). Wraps the proprietary Google Mobile Ads and UMP SDKs, see nativeDependencies

react-native-udp.note: Tempest hub UDP broadcast on the user's own Wi-Fi. Verify New Architecture support on first device build

com.google.mlkit:genai-prompt.license: ML Kit terms (Google APIs Terms + ML Kit GenAI Additional Terms)
com.google.mlkit:genai-prompt.note: Gemini Nano on-device (beta). Free; no key; users 18+ and app must not target minors; foreground only. modules/ondevice-llm/android

org.jetbrains.kotlinx:kotlinx-coroutines.note: Coroutines for the Android planner bridge

FoundationModels.framework.note: On-device only; Private Cloud Compute is not used. Weak-linked. modules/ondevice-llm/ios

Google-Mobile-Ads-SDK / com.google.andro.license: Google Mobile Ads SDK terms (proprietary, free)
Google-Mobile-Ads-SDK / com.google.andro.note: Ads on the free plan (tiers model) or in the ads-supported open-source build. Revenue share, not a cost. Not F-Droid compatible: an F-Droid flavour must build without it (EXPO_PUBLIC_ADS=off and without the plugin)

StoreKit.framework.note: In-app purchases; Apple takes its commission (15% in the Small Business Program)

com.android.billingclient:billing (9.x).note: Play Billing; Google takes its service fee (15% total in the US on the first $1M and on subscriptions)
